title: predicate
description: The typed middle coordinate p of a predication cell (s, p, o) - what is asserted of the subject in relation to the object. Not a bare label: it ranges over the predicate set and inhabits the predicate category whose four canonical morphism classes license reindexing of cells.

value.description: an element of the predicate set Pi, the typed index in Phi = E x Pi x E

morphismClasses.description: the four canonical morphism classes of the predicate category C that make the index compose and license reindexing

typed.description: the predicate is a categorical coordinate, not a string label; its typing transports a value asserted at one cell to related cells along the morphism classes
